reviews.title: USB issues, just flakely
reviews.comment:
This is the 3rd z690-a board I have gotten in the past month. The 1st 2 were DOA. Installed this one with a NVME drive from my old 4th gen PC running Windows 10. Boots to windows and BSOD due to driver fault error. Booted to safe mode and installed all new MSI drivers.
Boots normally but USB devices do not work when plugged in after booting into windows. They work if they are already plugged in. Uninstalled and reinstalled USB drivers. Same issue.
Removed the original NVME and installed a new one, doing a clean install of Win10. Same issue with USB drivers. This includes onboard and case front panel.
I have done another build for my gaming rig with a MSI z790, moving my old drive over and installing drivers with no USB issues or anything else for that matter.
